claims.subject: quasi-2-D model accuracy versus aspect ratio
claims.object: good for high aspect ratio (errors <= 6.7% for AR >= 4) and poor for low aspect ratio (29.3%/18.8% at AR 1)
claims.statement: The quasi-2-D model matches CFD better at high aspect ratio: temperature-increase discrepancy 29.3% at AR 1 but 1.2% at AR 8, pressure-drop discrepancy 18.8% and 4.4%; the channel bases (heat transfer Eqs. 28-29, friction Eq. 10) use a less accurate 1-D treatment, which dominates at low aspect ratio.
qualifiers: straight smooth channels, supercritical methane, imposed wall temperature
claims.quote: The quasi-2-D model solution approximates the CFD solution in a better way
